multi_capability_finding.claim_upgraded: Prior cycles labeled multi-capability -N>1 a known separate gap / out-of-scope. Empirically, under `hermit run --strict` it is ALSO reproducible with the timerfd virtualization.
multi_capability_finding.mechanism: `--strict` implies sequentialize_threads, so Detcore deterministically serializes all RTS capabilities onto the single virtual CPU; with the ticker virtualized the entire schedule (and genSym/Unique order) is a pure function of virtual time regardless of -N. Different -N values give different-but-stable aggregate hashes (a different but deterministic schedule).
multi_capability_finding.true_gap: A genuine multi-capability parallel-genSym nondeterminism gap would only appear under `--no-sequentialize-threads` (true parallel execution), which is a separate future backend goal, not the stock `--strict` path.
multi_capability_finding.control_caveat: The -N1 no-timerfd-virtualization control was 3/3 distinct (oldstock). A direct -N>1 no-fix control was not re-run (that binary is not staged), but the host-timed-ticker nondeterminism mechanism applies identically across -N, so the fix is the enabler.
